notes: Build/testing policy: every test-running cell carries an explicit -DMDBX_CHECKING>0 (the checked tier is RelWithDebInfo + CHECKING=2 + DEBUG=1 — RelWithDebInfo keeps the tests fast where the Debug build type carries no platform meaning); the only exceptions are the designated Release cells with the debug fully off (the all-warnings gate, the old-image compat cell, the arm pair, macos-macos15-release, and the ci-windows amalgamated job), which verify that everything builds warning-free and works without debugging.

The Debug build type matters over Release only on Windows with MDBX_WITHOUT_MSVC_CRT=OFF (it selects the CRT runtime); elsewhere it just trades optimization for the implicit CHECKING/DEBUG defaults, so the non-Windows tiers set them explicitly.
Sanitizer cells (ASan/UBSan) build RelWithDebInfo with CHECKING=2 (mirrors make test-asan/test-ubsan); the profgc cell keeps Release + CHECKING=1 for a representative profile.

cell counts: linux=23 (14 domain incl. the sanitizer/warnings/coverage cells + 8 MDBX_LOCKING flavors + the warnings gate), macos=3, win-msvc=44, win-cxx=78, win-mscl=18, win-mingw=9, android=15 build-only + 1 emulator; total=191.

Runner policy: prefer the latest GitHub runner images; a minimal set of compat configs stays on old ones (exactly one ubuntu-24.04 cell; the `make dist` job keeps ubuntu-24.04). MDBX_LOCKING is fixed on Windows (a platform limitation), so the LOCKING flavors are Linux-only.
full = union of the domain cells (no duplicate ids).

Android cells are build-only except the emulator pilot (android-r27d-x86-64-emu): boots an API-30 x86_64 AVD and runs smoke_basic/smoke_chk via adb. Kept in the nightly profiles for the stability signal; not part of the change-addressed gate.
push-quick profile: 6 linux + 1 macos + 3 windows (v142 win2022, v145 winlatest, mingw) = 10 cells, fast scope, on every push to devel/master and on every pull_request.

the nightly profiles belong to the platform workflows (ci-linux/ci-windows/ci-macos/ci-android, full scope); the CI_NIGHTLY marker (GTEST_SHUFFLE) travels via the ci-run.yml nightly input; ci-linux additionally runs the classic `make check` gate.
zones_notes: CI v3.5 model: change-addressed gate = union(push-quick, win-gate). Push on devel/master and every pull_request run push-quick (10 cells, fast scope; Windows = v142 on win2022 + v145 on winlatest + mingw). A change touching any common_prefix (src/, CMakeLists.txt, mdbx.h, .github/workflows/, ...) is addressed by change-addressed = push-quick∪win-gate (19 cells), which covers the full Windows axis matrix (v142/v143/v145, mscl, mingw, x64/win32/arm64, mscrt on/off, shared on/off, debug/release), Linux, macos. The repeated stochastic coverage belongs to the platform-nightly full-scope profiles (linux-nightly 12 + win-gate 9 + mac-nightly 3 + android-nightly 4; ci-linux also runs `make check`). Consistency and axis coverage are enforced by tests/ci/validate-config.py (CI job + make test-ci-config).
